children: The St. Joe Company said its JV with Minto will add approximately 3,500 homes in a second phase at Latitude Margaritaville Watersound, taking planned homes to about 7,200; sales are up 27% YTD 2026 and have reached 2,635 of the initial 3,700.
Signals larger build-out pipeline and potential future lot/home revenue.
Doubles community scale, implying extended multi-year demand.
High absorption reduces execution risk on next phase.
May improve JOE economics given higher regional values.

This is a mid-cycle confirmation of strong demand and JOE’s strategy to scale its Northwest Florida residential platform. For a bigger catalyst, investors need clarity on updated JV economics, pace of phase-two approvals, and conversion of sales to revenue/cash flow.
